Mari Chen: I'm seeing a 422 on /v1/rerank for a customer payload that has 'query' inside each doc. They say it used to work. Example payload below.
Alex Garcia: can you paste the exact body and curl you used?
Mari Chen: ```json
{
  "query": "How to cancel subscription",
  "docs": [
    {"id": "d1", "text": "Steps to cancel...", "query": "internal note"},
    {"id": "d2", "text": "Contact support..."}
  ]
}
```
Mari Chen: Response: 422 Unprocessable Entity
{"error":"Ambiguous field 'query' found in docs vs root; please use 'passages' or rename nested fields"}

Jordan Patel: hmm that looks like nested field shadowing. The rerank schema treats 'query' as reserved at top-level. If a doc has a 'query' key it flattens and confuses the mapper.

Alex Garcia: can you repro with curl + headers? Also what model/version are they hitting?
Mari Chen: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d @payload.json
```
payload.json is the JSON above. They use model "rerank-1".

support-bot: Help article: https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank#input-shape recommends 'candidates' or 'passages' arrays and avoiding top-level key name collisions. :eyes:

Jordan Patel: quick workaround: rename nested 'query' -> 'note' on their side and send docs as {id,text,metadata:{...}} then rerank will ignore metadata. Not ideal but unblock.

Alex Garcia: filing internal ticket CS-4782 to update docs and add a clearer error message. tagging infra team.

Mari Chen: customer is blocked, requesting P1 escalation due to production outage (search re-ranker returning 422). I'll attach logs and repro steps to the ticket.

Alex Garcia: thanks — also can you include full request id from the 422? that'll help trace.
Mari Chen: request id: req_abc123xyz

Jordan Patel: added :thumbsup: to the ticket and suggested adding a validation error recommending 'candidates' vs 'docs' and flagging nested 'query' keys. 
Mari Chen: will follow up when CS-4782 has a patch or docs update. :thinking:
